introduction: Texas weatherization funds qualifying energy-efficiency work through local providers. An energy audit helps determine which measures fit the home.
description: Texas weatherization funds qualifying energy-efficiency work through local providers. An energy audit helps determine which measures fit the home.

sections.who: The provider reviews household eligibility and whether the dwelling can benefit from the proposed work.
sections.get: Measures may include insulation, sealing leaks or approved heating and cooling improvements. This is not a general renovation allowance.
sections.docs:
• Income information.
  • Dwelling and occupancy information.
  • Requested ownership or rental records.
sections.apply:
1. Locate the provider

    Choose Weatherization in Help for Texans.

  2. Complete local intake

    Ask about required documents and waiting lists.

  3. Arrange assessment

    Discuss the dwelling and approved audit measures.
sections.after: Wait for authorization before arranging work you expect the program to cover.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Weatherization services, Local intake. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Can I apply directly to TDHCA?
Individual intake is through local providers.
Does approval mean every repair is covered?
The program targets energy-saving measures identified for the home.
What if no provider can assist?
TDHCA recommends also checking city or county resources.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
